text:
You want to speed up manga scene drafting by turning your ideas into polished, manga-oriented text without using AI-generated content.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, NLP, and machine learning. While my background is technical, I’m comfortable working carefully from your outlines and refining them into clean, natural dialogue and scene flow.

One relevant project was Clinical note summarisation for Brightwell Clinics, where I built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model to draft visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs were masked. It reached ROUGE-L 0.41 and reduced clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial.

If helpful, I can work from your scene drafts and help shape them into stronger, more readable manga-style text while staying closely aligned with your vision and avoiding AI-like phrasing.
